crossRefs.note: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

translations.web: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
translations.bsb: He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.
translations.kjv: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
translations.asv: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath sated me with wormwood.
